data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 28.9m (2014: GBP 24.8m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a favourable prior-year movement of GBP 28.9m on gross claims reserves for the year, representing a release of c.25% of the opening gross claims outstanding. This movement is described as favourable claims development on prior years' gross claims reserves; no specific named catastrophe or single large loss is identified as driving the movement in the disclosed text.
raw_causal_phrases: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 28.9m (2014: GBP 24.8m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2014.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding, 2014 comparative column). Prior-year development taken from explicit narrative sentence stating a GBP 28.9m favourable movement on prior year GROSS claims reserves (page 28). No breakdown of the prior-year movement by line of business or specific accident years was provided. Claims triangle is available (gross) and was not used as primary source because the narrative explicitly quantified the gross prior-year movement. LOB mapping (Casualty) is inferred from the syndicate's stated focus on third-party liability; confidence in LOB-specific allocation is moderate.
